title: VictoriaMetrics VMAgent creation grants a tenant access to cluster-wide Secrets
summary: With the documented default cluster-wide watch configuration, a namespace tenant able to create a VMAgent can cause the operator to create a ServiceAccount in the tenant namespace and bind it to a cluster-scoped role granting cluster-wide Secret read/list/watch. Because the tenant can mint a token for that namespaced ServiceAccount, it can read Secrets across namespaces and use available secrets or workload permissions to escalate further, potentially to cluster-admin. The tested versions and permissions are preserved in the advisory.
ai_role: The VictoriaMetrics Operator advisory explicitly credits finder Artem Cherezov with Claude Opus 4.7 and includes a verified reproduction. It does not state the internal discovery date.
classification_note: The primary maintainer advisory documents public disclosure but does not establish whether defenders knew of the issue or whether it was exploited before disclosure.
remediation_note: The advisory lists fixes in operator versions 0.68.7 (LTS) and 0.73.0. Release availability does not establish downstream deployment.

impacts.conditions: A tenant with namespace edit permissions and permission to create VMAgent resources can trigger default operator behavior that creates a tenant-namespaced ServiceAccount with cluster-wide Secret read/list/watch. The advisory describes cluster-admin escalation paths via accessible secrets.
impacts.exploitation: The advisory presents a verified test reproduction; it does not report exploitation in the wild.
